pkgmetadata.longdescription: Kilo Code is an open-source AI coding agent CLI (the upstream project also ships a VS Code extension, which this package does not install). This ebuild packages the prebuilt glibc x86_64/arm64 release tarball, which bundles a static bubblewrap 0.11.2 binary (GNU LGPL-2) as the sandbox runtime alongside the main "kilo" executable, tree-sitter grammar files, and sandbox worker scripts.
